name: band single arm shoulder press
description: A one-arm overhead press against a band. It trains the shoulders and makes your core resist twisting.
instructions: Stand on the band with your feet hip width apart and hold the other end at shoulder height.
Brace your core and keep your ribs down.
Press the hand straight overhead until your arm is almost straight.
Lower under control back to your shoulder.
Complete your reps without leaning sideways.
